title: A CONTROLLER SEES WHERE THE MAP MARKER GOES
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. On a controller the right stick moves a cursor over the open sector map and a tap of D-UP places the marker there, but that cursor was never drawn. The only pointer on the map was the mouse arrow, wherever the real mouse happened to sit, so a pad player placed his marker blind, and the header told him to CLICK, a button a pad does not have. The cursor is now drawn as a ring and cross where the marker will land, and on a controller the header says R STICK to move it and D-UP to place it. The mouse wording is unchanged.
now: On a controller the sector map now shows where your marker will land, and says R STICK and D-UP.

edits.anchor: try{ if(NET.on) netMapDots(ox,oy,sc,_pmz); }catch(_nmd){}   // v16.08: the party on the sector map (the net section)
ctx.fillText(G.waypoint?'CLICK set waypoint  ·  RIGHT-CLICK clear':'CLICK to set a waypoint',_hx,_hdY);
